name: Cloud scheduled tasks
summary: Save a task that runs in the cloud on a schedule, from an API call or on GitHub events, even with your laptop closed.
what: A cloud scheduled task (formerly called a routine) is a saved setup of prompt, repositories and connectors that runs as a cloud session. It can fire on a schedule, when an API endpoint is called, or on GitHub events. It is a research preview.

impact.title: Runs without you
impact.detail: Daily reviews or checks happen while your computer is off.

impact.title: Triggered by events
impact.detail: Start work from an alert, an API call or a pull request.

impact.title: Uses your tools
impact.detail: Connectors like Slack or Linear work during runs.

howItWorks: Create one at claude.ai/code/routines, in the desktop app, or with /schedule.
Describe it in plain words, such as /schedule daily PR review at 9am.
Manage them with /schedule list, update and run.
Custom schedules run at most hourly.
Needs a Pro, Max, Ultra, Team or Enterprise plan.
